review_candidates.title: Python Software Engineer - Ubuntu Hardware Certification Team
review_candidates.description: Canonical is hiring a Python Software Engineer to join the Certification team, who make the tools which enable us to know that a desktop, laptop, server or IoT device is working properly. We work at the interface of hardware and software, so the ideal candidate is a Python developer familiar with hardware. The Certification team develops the tools needed to certify hardware as working with Ubuntu Core as well as Ubuntu Desktop and Server: https://ubuntu.com/certified We design hardware which can be used to probe devices independently, and frameworks for software tests that check every aspect of Ubuntu on that hardware. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact for adoption of Linux across multiple device categories and industries. Canonical offers a fun, fast-paced team environment and a career full of learning and development opportunities. This team is centered in EMEA time zones, and works with colleagues on related teams in both the Americas and APAC. We work together with silicon companies, OEMs, ODMs and teams within Canonical to ensure a smooth, secure out of the box Ubuntu experience, with success in this role leading to a great Ubuntu experience being offered on more and more devices. Role description We are looking for a self-motivated software engineer with experience developing in Python, to work on test automation tools or Linux based embedded hardware. This role offers an exciting opportunity to push the industry forward by enabling entirely new Linux based hardware testing capabilities, scaling up hardware certification efforts and allowing for deeper test coverage. The role involves the development and maintenance of Canonical’s open source certification tools, supporting the creation of hardware solutions for test automation, and automating our existing processes. We seek out continuous process and tooling improvements as part of expanding the certification test suites, ultimately to improve the quality of Linux experience felt by millions of Linux end users. Key responsibilities Maintain and develop new features to our Python based test automation tools like Checkbox, used by both in-house teams and industry partners. Invent new ways to enable remote, automated testing. Help build the software counterpart to in-house designed testing hardware to help test device enablement (graphics, hotplug, bluetooth, etc). Write functional and performance tests to support hardware enablement and to protect from regressions. Participate in meetings involving international travel 2-3 times per year. Required Skills And Experience Knowledge of Python programming language. Quality oriented, pragmatic approach to software design and implementation. Interest in test automation methodologies. Previous experience working with Ubuntu or other Linux distributions. Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team. Desired Skills And Experience Passion for tinkering: you are a maker. Experience working in an agile environment. Hardware testing experience, for example in the IoT space. Familiarity with the C programming language. What is Canonical? Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu, “the world’s best free software platform”. Our services help businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #Stack

Key Responsibilities Solution Consolidation & Architecture Lead the technical design, refactoring, and integration required to merge distinct software portfolios into a unified .NET 10 Core and Blazor architecture. Analyze functional workflows in existing applications (WebForms, Angular, REST APIs) and re-architect them into clean, maintainable Blazor Web Apps and microservices. Greenfield Development & New Requirements Drive end-to-end software development for incoming business feature requests, translating complex business processes into high-quality technical implementations. Design reusable UI components, backend microservices, and integration pipelines using C# and modern .NET patterns. Manage deployment pipelines and containerized configurations for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Azure Container Registry (ACR) . Create and maintain automated CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) workflows within GitLab . Secure application endpoints using Azure AD / Entra ID (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT). Quality, Observability & Team Leadership Enforce software quality standards, conduct peer code reviews, and establish unit and integration testing suites (xUnit, NUnit). Configure application performance monitoring, log aggregation, and alerting dashboards using Grafana and Azure Application Insights. Provide L3 technical support for critical production incidents and perform root-cause analysis. Mentor the Junior Software Engineer and report regularly on delivery milestones to the Business Applications Manager. Candidate Competency Profile Mandatory Technical Skills Core Languages & Frameworks: C# (Advanced), .NET 8 / .NET 10 Core (Web API, Middleware, Background Services), Blazor (Server & WebAssembly), LINQ. Transitional Stack Understanding: Practical experience with C# 7.3+, ASP.NET Framework 4.8 (WebForms/Web API 2), and Angular to effectively extract, refactor, and merge business logic into Blazor. Data Access & Databases: Advanced SQL; expert-level proficiency in Oracle PL/SQL and PostgreSQL (query tuning, indexing, stored procedures, multi-tenant schema isolation). EF Core, EF6, Dapper, ADO.NET, ODP.NET. Architecture & Messaging: Microservices, RESTful API design (OpenAPI/Swagger), Event-Driven Architecture, Azure Service Bus , SOLID principles, Design Patterns. Cloud & DevOps: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) , Azure Container Registry (ACR) , Docker, Azure AD / Entra ID , GitLab CI/CD . Testing & Tools: xUnit/NUnit, Moq, Postman/Swagger, Visual Studio. Strongly Preferred Skills Hands-on experience with SQL Server / Azure SQL . Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, or Helm). API Gateway administration ( Gravitee or equivalent). System monitoring and observability via Grafana . Nice to Have Certifications: Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204), or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD). Domain-Driven Design (DDD) expertise.

Present in more than 150 countries, Deloitte is distinct in its ability to help clients solve their most complex problems, from strategy to implementation. With access to a scaled, diverse, highly skilled, motivated, and engaged workforce, DIH is delivering complex technical solutions for clients’ most complex business problems, across portfolios that include ‘Strategy & Transactions’, ‘Customer’, ‘Engineering, AI & Data, ‘Enterprise, Technology & Performance’ and ‘Cyber’. DIH is aiming to become the destination for top talents in Egypt for a long, exciting career. You will combine data, analytics, and structured problem-solving to support work across distribution and manufacturing networks, inventory strategy, logistics, operating models, resilience, sustainability, and implementation planning. You will work with experienced consultants and client teams across EMEA. Your Work Will Include Prepare, cleanse, validate, and analyze data from supply chain, logistics, finance, and operational sources. Build clear visualizations, scenario comparisons, and business-case analyses that support strategic decisions. You organize your work, explain your reasoning in accessible language, and contribute reliably in multicultural teams. You're ready to learn. You seek feedback, adapt to new tools and topics, and take ownership of building both digital and supply chain knowledge. Essentials A bachelor's or master’s degree in business informatics, Industrial Engineering, Business Engineering, Data Analytics, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related discipline. 0–2 years of professional experience in supply chain strategy, business analysis, data analytics, or consulting. Practical ability to analyze structured data and explain what the results mean for a business decision. Confidence using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint to develop analyses and communicate a clear storyline. Ability to communicate and present in English in writing and in meetings with colleagues and (senior) stakeholders. Interest in supply chain, logistics, strategy, operations, and technology-enabled business transformation. Coursework, internships, or project experience in supply chain planning, logistics, network design, inventory, or operations research. Hands-on experience using generative AI or AI-enabled tools to accelerate research, analyze data, automate routine tasks, perform quality checks, or develop business communications and presentations. Exposure to optimization, simulation, geographic analysis, or scenario-modelling methods. Experience working in project teams, consulting, case competitions, or client-facing assignments. Connect to your business – Technology & Transformation Distinctive thinking, deep expertise, and collaborative working. That’s what connects us. That’s what makes us Deloitte. If you want to help solve some of the biggest challenges around, join us. Together, we’ll make an impact that matters. Enterprise Data Platform komponentlərinin, o cümlədən etibarlılığı və məlumatlara əlçatanlığı artıran xüsusi data və platforma məhsullarının qurulması, saxlanılması və təkmilləşdirilməsində iştirak edəcəksiniz. Vəzifə öhdəlikləri On-premises data infrastrukturunun layihələndirilməsi, qurulması və saxlanılmasında iştirak etmək. Daxili komandalar üçün etibarlılığı, məlumatlara əlçatanlığı və istifadə rahatlığını artıran xüsusi data və platforma məhsullarını qurmaq və təkmilləşdirmək. Platformanın etibarlılığını və performansını təmin etmək üçün monitorinq, xəbərdarlıq və avtomatlaşdırma həllərini tətbiq etmək və dəstəkləmək. Data platforması komponentlərinin və saxlama sistemlərinin performansının tənzimlənməsi və optimallaşdırılmasına kömək etmək. Daxili istifadəçilərlə (Software Engineer və Data Engineer komandaları) əlaqə saxlayaraq rəy toplamaq və onların gündəlik ehtiyaclarını dəstəkləmək. İnkişaf planına uyğun olaraq platformanın yenilənməsi və miqrasiyası işlərində iştirak etmək. Namizədə tələblər Üstünlük verilir: DevOps, DataOps və ya DBA kimi oxşar vəzifələrdə ən azı 3 il iş təcrübəsi, o cümlədən etibarlılığı və məlumatlara əlçatanlığı artıran xüsusi data və platforma məhsullarının qurulması üzrə praktiki təcrübə. On-premises Data Lakehouse infrastrukturu haqqında anlayış. Linux inzibatçılığı və Kubernetes (K8s), CI/CD pipeline-ları, Git, Prometheus, Grafana və sirlərin idarə olunması üçün Vault daxil olmaqla əsas DevOps alətləri ilə iş təcrübəsi. Ceph, MinIO (S3 uyğun) obyekt saxlama texnologiyalarının idarə olunması üzrə təcrübə. PostgreSQL, Oracle kimi verilənlər bazası texnologiyalarından biri və ya bir neçəsi ilə iş təcrübəsi. Trino, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Apache Kafka, Apache NiFi və ya dbt kimi data platforması alətləri ilə tanışlıq. review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer – Platform & Reliability
review_candidates.description: About Maesn Want to join a growing European startup early and be part of an epic journey? At Maesn we build software for other software companies. We provide an integration platform that lets B2B software companies add integrations to their platforms in hours and days instead of weeks and months. Our customers love us because we are innovative, quick, friendly and provide integrations for systems that others dare not touch. We are a young dynamic SaaS Startup born in Düsseldorf who believe in working hard and having fun while doing it. You will have the chance to work on all parts of our technology stack and in close collaboration with our customers, to understand their needs and get direct feedback on the changes you ship. The role Our platform sits between our customers and dozens of third-party accounting and ERP systems. That makes reliability part of our product. When a call is slow or fails, our customers need to know why, and so do we. You’ll be the senior engineer who owns how our platform runs in production, and you’ll keep building the product alongside the team. You’ll work directly with our CTO, Lennart Svensson, and the wider founder team. What you will do Own our Azure infrastructure end-to-end You know every service, how it’s deployed and what it costs. You’ll tighten what’s there and codify what isn’t. As we scale, you’ll keep the architecture simple: we run on managed services and plan to keep it that way. Bring real observability to the platform Metrics, logs, traces and alerts, across our services and the third-party APIs we call. You’ll define what “healthy” means, build the dashboards, and set up alerting and on-call so we catch problems before our clients do. When a mysterious timeout appears, you’re the one who can trace it to its source. Raise the bar on security and reliability Fintechs trust us with sensitive financial data. You’ll harden the platform, make sure we can deliver on incident response and SLAs, and keep us audit-ready as customers ask for certifications like SOC 2 or ISO 27001. Build product and level up the team You’ll ship features and integrations with the rest of the engineering team. You’ll also be the go-to person for production debugging, and you’ll mentor our engineers so the whole team gets better at running what we build. What you bring Experience: 5+ years building and running backend services in production, including real ownership of infrastructure, deployments and incidents. Production debugging: You’ve chased down latency spikes, timeouts and flaky dependencies, and you know how to go from “something is slow” to the root cause. Azure: Solid hands-on experience running production workloads on Azure. Observability: Experience instrumenting services with tracing, structured logging and metrics, ideally with OpenTelemetry or similar. Infrastructure-as-code mindset: You codify infrastructure rather than clicking through consoles. Security by default: You think about secrets, access management, and compliance as part of the work, not as an afterthought. Backend skills: You’re comfortable writing production code in TypeScript/Node.js and enjoy shipping features, not only keeping the lights on. Pragmatism and mentoring: You pick the simplest setup that works. You enjoy helping less experienced engineers grow, and you’re excited to set the standards for how we run our platform. What we offer First-hand experience building a fast-growing tech startup Kind teammates and great collaborative atmosphere Steep learning curve and a varied job with interesting projects and technologies Work fully remote or in our office in Düsseldorf Fun offsites where the team gets together to work and play One-time allowance for improving your home office Subsidized Urban Sports Club membership Laptop and work equipment 30 days of PTO + Local holidays
